versions.rationale: Single patch for experiment-population provenance and selective telemetry-loss guidance. No dependency or Java baseline change.

baseline.attribution: Assignment was clean; all six hashes matched the coordinator's wave-two snapshot. All final package differences are this reviewer's.

findings.gap: Existing allocation/interference and missing-evidence guidance did not provide a concrete path from randomized assignment/exposure through logging/export/joins/filters to analysed observations.
findings.consequence: Balanced arm/sample counts can conceal outcome-dependent selection; a treatment may look faster because slower observations disappeared.
findings.correction: Trace population provenance, audit at the actual assignment unit, investigate unexplained SRM without presuming its cause, check arm/cohort loss, repair/reanalyse the affected pipeline and preserve independently supported metrics.

changes.details: Two-line guard links experimental comparison to actual assignment/logging/filtering populations.
Added one conditional design bullet for population provenance, sample-ratio mismatch versus selective loss, actionable artifacts and scoped correction; two primary references.
Added a corresponding population-reconciliation check while measuring.

preserved: Defining the decision/estimand and an adequate no-change path without requiring an unneeded profiling campaign.
Effective JVM flags, workload/version context and missing incident evidence limits.
Falsifiable hypotheses and separation of observed effect from causal mechanism.
Fixed-work Amdahl bounds, critical-path caveats, non-additive percentiles and queueing model assumptions.
Independent experimental units, randomized/block designs, interactions, shared-resource interference and switchback carry-over.
Warmup/state evolution, restart/canary confounds, production collection budgets, stopping criteria and all-run reporting.
Existing folklore and reporting examples are byte-for-byte unchanged.

javaCompatibility.baseline: Existing JDK 25 authoring references retained; deployed project runtime must still be inspected. No JVM feature, dependency, compiler flag or build upgrade was introduced.
